title: Tall whites came in the last ice age to use Earth as a pit stop

tellings.quote: >> Well, they came here in the middle of the last ice age because we for the same reason that we have a base on Guam.

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall, pale aliens he calls the 'tall whites' at Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada, says they first came to Earth in the middle of the last ice age. He tells Michels they use Earth as a pit stop on their travels, 'for the same reason that we have a base on Guam.'
